headline: US Universities to establish physical campuses in India; Trilegal advises
sum: Trilegal has advised global education company Emeritus (part of Eruditus) on its strategic joint ventures with Illinois Institute of Technology, University of Aberdeen, University of New South Wales (UNSW) and University of Victoria for…
detail: Trilegal has advised global education company Emeritus (part of Eruditus) on its strategic joint ventures with Illinois Institute of Technology, University of Aberdeen, University of New South Wales (UNSW) and University of Victoria for the establishment of physical campuses in India. The Firm provided comprehensive legal advisory support throughout the transactions, from inception through execution and closing. The responsibilities included structuring and negotiating transaction documentation, while providing strategic guidance on governance architecture, operational frameworks, and compliance considerations.
